sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!

sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: I was defeated by... basic clothing maintenance.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed and mildly self-mocking, quietly frustrated at her clumsy start to the day but trying to soften it with dry, understated humor.
sprite_sequence.label: neutral

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels stunned, quietly exasperated, and a little helpless, as if the morning’s absurd string of mishaps has left her too tired to do anything but stare in disbelief.

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is quietly exasperated but still oddly composed, shifting from disbelief to determined problem-solving as she accepts the absurdity and looks for the next option.
sprite_sequence.label: neutral

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and mortified, with a sudden anxious urge to apologize and make amends while trying not to panic outwardly.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is startled and flustered, with a brief spike of panic as the hot croquette burns her, but she’s still trying to stay quiet and composed.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.text: Thank you... and I'm really sorry.

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is stunned into a small, exhausted silence, feeling mortified and defeated but trying to keep her composure after one absurd mishap after another.
sprite_sequence.label: neutral

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is on the verge of laughing and crying at once, overwhelmed by absurd bad luck and tenderly mourning the croquette as if it were a small, earnest victim of the morning.
sprite_sequence.label: sadness

sprite_sequence.text: If even breakfast gave up... maybe I can stop panicking for one second.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels exhausted and absurdly defeated, but a tiny, shaky sense of relief is letting her turn her panic into quiet, self-deprecating humor for a moment.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: Oh. Right. That would have been worse.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a quiet, delayed jolt of relief mixed with lingering embarrassment, realizing with subdued gratitude that she narrowly avoided an even bigger mistake.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and chastened, but also quietly relieved to be caught before making things worse, so she answers with timid, apologetic compliance.

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed and self-conscious about how obvious her chaotic morning has been, but there’s a faint, sheepish humor underneath her quiet concern.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels exhausted and relieved, with a faint, embarrassed sense of triumph after barely surviving the morning’s chaos.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: Please let the disasters stay outside the school today.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is quietly exhausted and anxious, but trying to steady herself with a small, hopeful plea for the day to finally go normally.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

gpt.rationale: The sequence is mostly subdued and fittingly introverted—quiet neutral/sad beats and small relief-smiles work well—though repeated overt fear/surprise on several mishaps feels slightly more externally expressive than this personality suggests.

claude.rationale: Sprites track the emotional beats well (fear, surprise, the helpless happiness, the croquette sadness), but the frequent loud fear/surprise reactions and overt panic clash with a reserved, soft-spoken introvert who keeps strong feelings inside.
